events.title: Moonshot Kimi K2 released
events.summary: Moonshot AI open-sourced Kimi K2 on July 11, 2025 — a 1T-parameter MoE model with 32B active parameters, optimized for agentic coding and tool use.
events.about: Kimi K2 brought Chinese open-weight models to the agentic frontier: strong SWE-bench scores, Modified MIT license, and reflex-grade tool calling without long thinking chains. It proved Moonshot could ship trillion-parameter open models competitive with Western closed APIs — right as DeepSeek R1 had already shaken inference economics.

narrative.whyChosen: Kimi K2 made open agentic intelligence a credible alternative to closed coding models.
narrative.whyImportant: Chinese labs expanded from reasoning shocks to open trillion-parameter agent platforms.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams wanted o3-class agentic coding with weights they could self-host and fine-tune.
